description: A masked text input that enforces a specific format as the user types. Supports digit, letter, alphanumeric and wildcard mask rules with optional literal inclusion.

parameters.name: Mask
parameters.description: The mask pattern. Use '0' for digits, 'L' for letters, 'A' for alphanumeric, '&' for any char. Other characters are treated as literals.

parameters.name: PromptChar
parameters.description: The character displayed in empty positions. Defaults to underscore.

parameters.name: IncludeLiterals
parameters.description: Whether the value includes literal characters from the mask. When false, only user-typed characters are stored. Defaults to true.

parameters.name: Value
parameters.description: The current value. When IncludeLiterals is true, this includes mask literals. When false, only user-typed characters are stored.

parameters.name: ValueChanged
parameters.description: Event fired when the value changes.

parameters.name: Placeholder
parameters.description: Placeholder text shown when the input is empty.

parameters.name: AdditionalCssClass
parameters.description: Additional CSS classes for the input element.

parameters.name: Id
parameters.description: HTML id attribute for the input.
